items.title: Pay Preetish $1000 for his work on the hackathon
items.detail: Anjali Kalavar called it super high priority and due tomorrow, and said explicitly that she will not take it on herself. No one else was named, so it is unowned.

provenance.author: Anjali Kalavar
provenance.quote: We also need to remember to pay Preetish $1000 for all his hard work on the hackathon.
